unit: unique versioned paper and repository pair

selection.ordering: ascending SHA-256 of ordering_salt, paper_url_versioned, and code_url_versioned
selection.assignment: first 8 eligible units are development; next 72 are confirmatory

eligibility: one versioned repository URL per paper
one paper per exact versioned repository URL
versioned paper PDF responds to a bounded request
repository commit archive responds to a bounded request
license text at the recorded commit is classified as MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, or CC-BY
post_materialization_independence_gate: Cluster exact and near-duplicate repository snapshots before final split sealing; assign connected components wholly to one split and replace collided units only from hash-ordered reserves
forbidden_inputs: All discrepancy counts and descriptions, gold relevant files, gold paper sections, changed files, and changed snippets
kill_rule: KILL_DATASET when fewer than 80 eligible independent units are found among the first 96 hash-ordered units, or when component-safe reassignment cannot preserve 8 development and 72 confirmatory units
execution_after_pass: Freeze the retrieval/evaluation contract before inspecting development retrieval outcomes; keep confirmatory gold in a separate sealed evaluator input until the method is frozen
